_comment: Compose from Lifepath. fields: every Lifepath option id of the seven fields maps to a short 'phrase' that slots into a sentence and a 1-3 word 'trait'. descriptionGrammar: sentence slots with 2-3 variants each (second person, never uses the character's name). Placeholders are the seven field names. Do not apply Tracery modifiers.
